desc: The DBAL-A3 civilian model is based on the standard issue DBAL-A3 for U.S. warfighters. This unit offers the latest advances in IR and visible laser technology. The dual-beam infrared laser and illuminator combination is extremely accurate in low and no light maneuvers. Also, features defocused adjustable IR illumination technology to enable both midrange and close quarter target acquisition, low-profile windage and elevation adjusters, dual remote cable ports remote fire and visible override, single laser activation switch tap and release for momentary activation, tap twice for 5 minute continuous on and activation/low battery indicator light. Attach to any Picatinny rail using patented, self-adjusting Quick Release HT Mount.
